t: These general handling gloves offer reliable protection and comfort for a wide range of tasks. Featuring a 10 gauge polycotton yellow liner, these work gloves provide a comfortable fit and good durability. The standard orange latex crinkle grip ensures excellent wet and dry handling, making them ideal for general construction, warehousing, and light assembly work. A breathable back enhances comfort during prolonged use, while elasticated cuffs provide a secure fit, preventing debris entry. These protective gloves are designed for trade professionals seeking dependable performance and a secure grip in various working conditions.
b: 10 Gauge Polycotton Liner Offers Comfort & Durability
Orange Latex Crinkle Grip Ensures Secure Handling
Good Abrasion & Tear Resistance For Durability
Provides Good Wet & Dry Grip Performance
